name: Hermes Agent
summary: Nous Research's self-improving open-source agent: terminal UI plus messaging gateway, agent-curated memory and skills it writes and refines from experience.
description: Works with any model provider (Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, custom endpoints; switch with `hermes model`). Features from the README: full TUI, one gateway process for Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp and Signal, autonomous skill creation compatible with the agentskills.io standard, FTS5 session search, Honcho user modelling, a built-in cron scheduler, isolated subagents, and seven terminal backends (local, Docker, SSH, Singularity, Modal, Daytona, Vercel Sandbox). Also ships batch trajectory generation for training tool-calling models. Install: `curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | bash` (native Windows via PowerShell).
